assets.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset type: final transparent FOUR-STATE SAVE-SLOT PALLET SPRITE ATLAS for The Picture Shop title menu.
Input1 is the APPROVED pallet button: preserve its exact low timber-pallet and cream paper-re am design, viewpoint, honey-brown slatted wood, three block supports, two dark forklift entry pockets, nailheads, crisp pixel outlines and delicately layered paper. Input2 is the approved cutter title, for matching finish.
Create FOUR matching copies of this approved pallet stacked in FOUR evenly spaced rows in one 1536x1024 landscape atlas. Every silhouette about1400x180, perfectly aligned and identical shape. Row centers approximately y130,385,640,895; xcenter768. True transparent margin and large clear gaps.
REMOVE ALL PRINTED WORDS from every paper face. The cream top paper face must be entirely blank and quiet for live slot number, status and cash text. Retain the paper's depth and thin layered front edges. Keep the top paper label surface generous, at least45 percent of overall sprite height, while recognizable wood pallet and fork pockets remain below.
State rows top to bottom:
1 NORMAL: the approved clean cream stack and honey wood, standard highlights.
2 HOVER: slightly lighter paper and warmer wood highlights, small brass-like highlight on the deck edge, clear but subtle.
3 SELECTED: warm amber-gold edging on the paper's perimeter and brighter amber front deck lip, strong visibly selected state. No external glow or additional icon, keep center cream for black text.
4 PRESSED: paper stack visibly lowered a little toward deck, compressed sheet layers and deeper lower edge shadows, with warm selected edging retained. Keep same outer mounting footprint as other states.
Use only these meaningful state changes. Avoid redesigning the pallet, extra shipping straps, clamps or tags. Flat horizontal front edge, slightly elevated front view, not diamond-isometric. Wide shallow slots, not tall paper cubes.
All outside pixels and inter-row gaps truly transparent alpha, no background, no checkerboard, no floor shadow. No words, letters, numbers, captions, state labels, icons, concepts or titles anywhere. Production sprite atlas only.

Use case: reference-inspired production sprite generation.
Asset type: EIGHT-FRAME TRANSPARENT PRINTER INK CONTAINER BUTTON ATLAS for The Picture Shop menu.
Reference 1 is the approved Polar 115 cutter title control: match its crisp outlined pixel-art finish, worn ivory enamel, machined silver edges, brass accents, tactile industrial print shop style. Reference 2 is the approved paper pallet button: match the rendering and cream paper label color, not its wooden shape.
Draw EIGHT low, WIDE cylindrical industrial printing ink tins, in a precise TWO COLUMN by FOUR ROW atlas, 1536x1024. Each button tin is about 660 pixels wide and 160 pixels tall, front facing with a slightly elevated view, shallow oval rolled-rim silver lid, unmistakably curved metal tin sides and ellipse rim. A modest ink smear near the rim adds printing-shop character. Not a plain rectangular frame, not a toolbox, not a giant bucket, not a drum, not a generic UI rectangle.
LEFT COLUMN: petrol cyan/teal enamel ink tins, for normal actions.
RIGHT COLUMN: burgundy/red enamel ink tins, for danger actions.
Every tin has a wide, entirely BLANK cream paper label across its front, roughly 76 percent of body width and 45 percent of whole height, a calm bright rectangle for live dark game text. Keep tin color showing around and below label and silver rim prominent above. No markings on labels.
FOUR ROWS top to bottom: NORMAL, HOVER, PRESSED, DISABLED. Normal clean worn enamel, hover slightly brighter rim and body with warm brass highlight, pressed tin lowered/compressed slightly with darker lid inset and body shadows, disabled desaturated slate gray enamel and gray cream label with subdued metal highlights. Each matching state keeps identical alignment and shape. All normal actions share same left tint; danger right tint. Disabled both columns gray.
Position centers at x384 and1152, y128,384,640,896. Large truly transparent gaps between sprites, generous transparent margins. Do not crop any edge. Crisp dark pixel outlines and stepped edges, light subtle surface wear, limited controlled highlights, readable at small menu sizes.
Absolutely NO lettering, text, symbols, numbers, sample buttons, atlas headings, state captions, checkerboard, background, ground or cast shadow outside the tin. True alpha transparency throughout empty space. Production sprite atlas only.

Use case: reference-inspired precise-object-edit.
Asset type: FOUR-STATE TRANSPARENT TOOLBOX BUTTON SPRITE ATLAS for The Picture Shop title menu.
Reference 1 is the game's existing blue toolbox sprite: directly preserve its recognizable blue enamel case, dark carry handle, TWO brass lid latches, reinforced black/silver corners, restrained wear and crisp outlined pixel-art finish. Reference 2 is the approved Polar 115 cutter title: match its industrial printshop materials and sprite rendering quality.
Create FOUR wide shallow front-facing TOOLBOX button sprites stacked in FOUR evenly spaced rows on one 1536x1024 atlas. Each silhouette about1350x180 pixels. Row centers y128,384,640,896; xcenter768. Identical shape and alignment in all rows, true transparent margins and large empty gaps.
The toolbox must have a distinctive raised BLACK CARRY HANDLE centered above its lid, beveled blue steel lid, two BRASS CLOSURE LATCHES near left and right edges, blue front panel, dark reinforced corner plates, and a LARGE entirely BLANK cream rectangular NAMEPLATE across the center of the front panel. This quiet cream label must span about65 percent of the toolbox width and45 percent of overall height for dynamically drawn dark text. Hardware stays outside this nameplate. Wide low horizontal toolbox silhouette, not a blank generic metal frame, not a suitcase, not a pallet.
Rows top to bottom:
1 NORMAL: existing blue enamel color, silver lid edge, brass catches, clean cream nameplate.
2 HOVER: brighter blue enamel and warm brass edge accents, polished handle and lid highlights.
3 PRESSED: slightly lowered case/lid with deeper inset shadow, thinner bottom lip and visibly depressed face. Same mounting footprint.
4 DISABLED: desaturated gray-blue enamel, muted gray brass, pale gray nameplate, subdued highlights.
Use the reference's pixel-styled outlines, carefully stepped edge shading and subtle enamel chips. View directly from front with slight elevation showing lid depth. Preserve handle, two catches, reinforced corners. Modest scuffs, no busy rust or dirt. No added tools sticking out.
No words, letters, logos, numbers, icons, sample text, state captions or titles anywhere. All pixels outside each toolbox and between rows genuinely alpha transparent. No painted background, checkerboard, floor or cast shadow outside silhouette. Production game sprite atlas only.
